rules.note: Foster Place spaces reduced since May 2023 for planters and seating; spaces unknown until kerb-checked.
College Green may hold more cabs since 2023 (reported enlarged when Foster Place was cut); not kerb-checked.
When College Green / Dame Street close (summer Sundays, Culture Night) the College Green, Foster Place and Dame Street ranks are suspended and an extended temporary rank is set up on D'Olier Street
rules.short: Moved to D'Olier St when College Green closes

rules.note: During city-centre parades (Easter, St Patrick's) the O'Connell Street rank is replaced by a temporary rank opposite the southern side of the Rotunda Hospital
rules.short: Moved to the Rotunda on parade days

rules.note: Luas Cross City: only trams, buses and cyclists may travel on Dawson Street north of Duke Street; taxis on Dawson Street must exit via Molesworth Street
rules.short: Dawson St north of Duke St: trams only

rules.note: construction hoarding, barriers and cones occupy the south kerb of St Stephen's Green South near the night stands
rules.short: Works on this kerb seen Apr 2026
